task_definition.task_description: Check the current time in New York, then get the status of my living room light and turn its brightness down to 0. After that, find the lock ticket for the living room, archive that ticket with high priority as "Front Door Lock Archive" for Alice, and send her a notification that it has been archived. Finally, check Alice's Outlook calendar availability for February 22nd, 2026.

user_input.query: Please start by checking the current time in the America/New_York timezone. After that, I need you to check the status of my light_living device in the living_room and turn its brightness down to 0. Next, find the lock ticket for the living_room area and archive it with high priority using the title Front Door Lock Archive for Alice, whose user_id is u_alice. Make sure to send Alice a notification once it has been archived. Finally, please check the calendar availability for Alice using the calendar_item_id u_alice for February 22nd, 2026.
user_input.title: Front Door Lock Archive
